title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 206 West Commercial Street in East Rochester, New York, as the "Officer Daryl R. Pierson Memorial Post Office Building".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 206 West Commercial Street in East Rochester, New York, as the "Officer Daryl R. Pierson Memorial Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Names a post office building in East Rochester, New York, after Officer Daryl R. Pierson.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility at 206 West Commercial Street in East Rochester, New York, as the "Officer Daryl R. Pierson Memorial Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal services, rules, or staffing.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 5, 2015.
